actions.desc: On a success  the creature moves to a space within 5 feet of the cube. A creature within 5 feet can take the same action to free an engulfed creature  but takes 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage in the process.

actions.desc: The cube moves up to its Speed. While doing so  it can enter Large or smaller creatures spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creatures space  the creature makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. If the creature is unaware of the cubes presence  it makes its saving throw against Engulf with disadvantage. On a success  the creature may use its reaction  if available  to move up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the creature doesnt move  it is engulfed by the cube.

Характеристики: СИЛ 16, ЛОВ 2, ТЕЛ 18, ИНТ 1, МУД 6, ХАР 1. Иммунитет к состояниям: ослепление, очарование, глухота, истощение, испуг, положение ничком. Чувства: слепое зрение 60 фт., пассивное Восприятие 8. Показатель опасности: 7. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 4, действий: 4.
